newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indian refineries unaffected by power failure.
newsitem.headline: Indian refineries unaffected by power failure.

text.p: Operations at India's oil refineries have not been affected by a power failure across northern India on Friday, industry sources said.
"All the refineries have their own power generators .. they don't depend on it (the electricity grid)," said a source familiar to the largest state refiner, Indian Oil Corp (IOC).
IOC owns the only refinery in the affected area, the 152,000 barrel-per-day at Mathura, just south of New Delhi.

Power Authorities said New Delhi and the northern states of Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh were hit on Friday morning by the power failure, which was sparked by a major fault in the electricity grid. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3086)
